stages.title: Multi-view SfM, initial 3DGS training, and coordinate registration
stages.paper_scope: COLMAP reconstruction and camera estimation, gsplat/EWA optimization, and Gaussian-to-FE registration.
stages.candidate_behavior: The local continuous demonstration starts from an existing 399999-step real-tower checkpoint. Photos, COLMAP reconstruction, and long 3DGS training were not rerun.

stages.title: FE-beam-aligned structural ROI refinement and pruning
stages.paper_scope: Region-aware densification and pruning guided by the exact FE-beam capsule ROI during training.
stages.candidate_behavior: The chain uses the supplied 449999-step ROI-trained checkpoint and its exact-capsule ROI cache. It does not rerun the long training job or infer per-Gaussian clone/split/prune lineage.

stages.title: Terrain separation, Kriging, and multi-layer extension
stages.paper_scope: Notebook-aligned adaptive terrain/object classification, ordinary-Kriging terrain reconstruction, and constrained boundary extension.
stages.candidate_behavior: Rerun from the supplied ROI-trained checkpoint. An explicit exact-capsule structure guard was added because the original terrain thresholds misclassified structural points when transferred to this checkpoint; this guarded run is not the original notebook's unmodified numerical result.

stages.title: Wind-field loading and finite-element response
stages.paper_scope: Wind/turbulence synthesis, dynamic loading, nonlinear ANSYS/FE response, and three-component displacement histories.
stages.candidate_behavior: No wind-field generator or ANSYS/FE solve was rerun. The demonstration reuses the archived 399-frame registered displacement field from the author's source data and maps its 107844 historical moving samples to the 772827 target ROI Gaussians by nearest source position; source rows may be reused.
limitations: ANSYS model import and beam preprocessing are not an ANSYS solver.
Nearest-position transfer is not an exact Gaussian-ID match or the paper's full interpolation method.
The archived displacement field is not regenerated from wind or raw solver inputs.

stages.title: Deformation replay and dynamic gsplat rendering
stages.paper_scope: Right-polar rotation/stretch decomposition, Gaussian mean/orientation/scale/covariance updates, anisotropic FE-to-Gaussian propagation, and dynamic rendering.
stages.candidate_behavior: The verified continuous renderer updates moving Gaussian means as base_mean + scale_disp * registered_displacement and leaves static Gaussians unchanged. It renders four selected frames with gsplat; scale_disp=50 is a display amplification. Full polar/quaternion/log-scale/covariance updates are not executed by this continuous renderer.
